subject: Proposal: LangChain runtime binding — integration SOW and tracing hooks
messages:
From: Eduardo Ramos <eduardo@langchainlabs.com>
To: alex.martinez@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integration opportunity: LangChain runtime binding + trace hooks for Redwood

Hi Alex,

Hope youre well — Eduardo from LangChain Labs here. Weve been prototyping a runtime binding that plugs LangChain agents directly into hosted inference runtimes and includes a lightweight tracing hook for structured traces (span IDs + prompt metadata).

We think theres a good fit with Redwoods serving and observability stack: routing LangChains runtime calls to Redwood endpoints, shipping trace spans back to your console, and offering an optional packaged plugin customers can drop into their agent code.

High-level ask: can we scope a joint PoC (6-8 week) that delivers:
- a runtime binding for LangChain that targets Redwood API patterns
- a tracing shim that emits Redwood-compatible span events
- a short SOW and support plan for ISV distribution (docs + sample app)

I attached a short sketch (lc-runtime-proposal.md) and Id like to set up a technical deep-dive next week. Proposed agenda: architecture walkthrough, auth patterns (API key vs mTLS), trace payload contract, test harness.

Are you the right person to take this? If not, can you point me to the best contact at Redwood?

Best,
Eduardo Ramos
Product Partnerships
LangChain Labs

Attachments: lc-runtime-proposal.md
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Eduardo Ramos <eduardo@langchainlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration opportunity: LangChain runtime binding + trace hooks for Redwood

Eduardo,

Thanks for the intro and the proposal doc — this is squarely in our partner integrations lane. Im Alex (Partner Integrations, Redwood). Id love to run a technical deep-dive and map the scope to a realistic PoC.

Quick notes after skimming the sketch:
- Auth: Redwood supports API keys and a private deployment flow (mTLS) for Private customers; well want to enumerate both for the SOW.
- Tracing: Our console accepts span envelopes with token-level metadata; well share a minimal contract and example payloads in the deep-dive.
- Distribution: for an ISV plugin we typically ship a shim + example app and a compatibility matrix for model variants/quantization profiles.

Proposed next steps:
1) 60m technical deep-dive — Wed 2026-09-02 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET (youre on PT I think?)
2) Well circulate a draft SOW and an integration checklist ahead of the call (attached).
3) Post-call: align on PoC success criteria and a 6-week sprint plan.

I attached a quick integration checklist and a draft SOW to accelerate. Marissa (cc) will help with commercial and SOW approvals.

If Wed doesnt work propose a couple alternatives and well lock it.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Senior Partner Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood-integration-checklist.pdf; SOW-draft.docx
From: Eduardo Ramos <eduardo@langchainlabs.com>
To: alex.martinez@redwood.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration opportunity: LangChain runtime binding + trace hooks for Redwood

Alex / Marissa / Soojin,

Thanks — Wed 09/02 10:00 PT works for our eng and product leads. Well come prepared with a small reference runtime and a trace plugin prototype.

Couple items wed like to confirm on the call:
- commercial model: would Redwood prefer a referral-fee + joint GTM (you handle hosting) or a redistributed ISV package where we split revenue on plugin sales? Were open to both and want to surface tradeoffs.
- PoC test app: we can provide a small demo harness (attached) that runs an agent with two retrievers and exercise long-context token flows.
- security/compliance: a short checklist on data retention for span payloads would be helpful — well map to our SDK defaults.

Attachments: lc-trace-plugin-v0.patch; poa_test_harness.tar.gz

Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/meetings/zoom-2b7f8

See you Wed — Eduardo
Eduardo Ramos
Product Partnerships, LangChain Labs
eduardo@langchainlabs.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Integration opportunity: LangChain runtime binding + trace hooks for Redwood

Marissa / Soojin — forwarding the thread from LangChain Labs. Short summary and asks: 
- Partner wants a 6-week PoC for a runtime binding + tracing shim; theyre flexible on commercial model.
- Theyll demo a plugin prototype and a small test harness on the Wed call.
- I attached the SOW draft; would appreciate Marissas read on commercial terms and budget approval (DEAL: LCL-2026-778).
- Soojin: can you flag any immediate security retention constraints to surface on the call? Ill send the payload contract snippets before the meeting.

Immediate ask: Marissa, can you confirm whether we can run vendor-tier joint PoC (budget up to $20k infra credits + 8 hours SE support) under a partner MOU? If yes Ill include that in the SOW and route for signature.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martinez
Senior Partner Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com
